neighbours.label: the part right after a hyphen in a technical compound (read-only, cross-site, random-number), against the same words spaced
fire: The disk is mounted as read-only by the kernel.
Attackers used a cross-site request to steal the token.
Each client sends its user-agent string on connect.
Ranchers graze cattle on mixed-grass plains.
Good random-number sources are hard to build.
The New-York Tribune printed the story.
quiet: The disk is mounted so that you can only read it.
Attackers crossed the site to steal the token.
Each client sends its user name on connect.
Ranchers graze cattle on plains of mixed grass.
Good sources of random numbers are hard to build.
The New York Tribune printed the story.

notes: A broad pole (1.3% of tokens reach 0.1 of max); these are only the tokens I could reproduce. '_get' stayed at 0.06.
